import Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd.RemainingProfile
import Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd.ResidualColoring
import Overfull.Terminal.CoreBridge
import Overfull.Terminal.Reassembly

/-! Factor the actual residual profile and restore every completed prefix matching. -/

noncomputable section

namespace Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd

open Finset Classical SimpleGraph Multigraph SmallCuts ForeignPhase FourOdd Terminal

private theorem other_two_indices (x y : Fin 4) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ z w : Fin 4, z ≠ w ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 4, i=z ∨ i=w ∨ i=x ∨ i=y := by
  have hh : ∀ x y : Fin 4, x ≠ y →
      ∃ z w : Fin 4, z ≠ w ∧ z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y ∧ w ≠ x ∧ w ≠ y ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 4, i=z ∨ i=w ∨ i=x ∨ i=y := by decide
  exact hh x y hxy

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
theorem exists_uniform_completed_four_two_odd_factorization (α ν τ : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hν : 0 < ν) (hντ : ν ≤ τ)
    (hτ : τ ≤ α/64) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∃ m₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
        (U : Fin 4 → Finset V) (H : ∀ i, SimpleGraph (U i))
        (label : V → Fin 4) (x y : Fin 4) (h : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
        (P : FourTwoOddPrefix G U H label x y h a ν τ),
        (∀ i, labelShore label {i} = U i) → x ≠ y →
        (∀ i, (U i).card % 2 = if i=x ∨ i=y then 1 else 0) →
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (U i) (U j)) →
        (∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ U i) →
        (∀ i, m₀ ≤ (U i).card) →
        α*Fintype.card V ≤ ((h-P.rounds : ℕ) : ℝ) →
        (∀ i, α*Fintype.card V ≤ ((U i).card : ℝ)) →
        (∀ i, a ≤ η*(U i).card) →
        Nonempty ((Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph G).EdgeColoring h) := by
  obtain ⟨η,hη,m₀,hfactor⟩ := exists_uniform_four_two_odd_coloring α ν τ
    hα hα1 hν hντ hτ
  refine ⟨η,hη,m₀,?_⟩
  intro V _ G U H label x y h a P hparts hxy hparity hdisjoint hcover hm hk hsize ha
  obtain ⟨z,w,hzw,hzx,hzy,hwx,hwy,hindices⟩ := other_two_indices x y hxy
  let R := afterDeletions G P.completion.full P.rounds
  let C : ∀ i, Core (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R) (U i) :=
    completionCore P.completion P.rounds le_rfl
  have hregular : ∀ v, (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).degree v = h-P.rounds :=
    completionResidual_regular P.completion P.rounds le_rfl
  have hrobust (i : Fin 4) : IsRobustExpander (C i).graph ν τ :=
    completionCore_robust P.completion P.rounds le_rfl i
  have hdegree (i : Fin 4) (v : U i) :
      ((h-P.rounds : ℕ) : ℝ)-a ≤ ((C i).graph.degree v : ℝ) :=
    (completionCore_degree P.completion P.rounds le_rfl P.rounds_le i v).1
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hdM,hpartsM,hcut,hpar⟩ := P.exists_residual_primary_family hparts
  have hinst : (fun e f : R.edgeSet => propDecidable (e = f)) =
      (inferInstance : DecidableEq R.edgeSet) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hcoverM : ∀ e : R.edgeSet,
      e ∉ (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).internalEdges (U z) →
      e ∉ (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).internalEdges (U w) →
      e ∉ (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).internalEdges (U x) →
      e ∉ (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).internalEdges (U y) → ∃ j, e ∈ M j := by
    intro e hez hew hex hey
    have hjoin : e ∈ joiningCopies (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R) label := by
      apply (mem_joiningCopies _ _ e).mpr
      intro heq
      let i := label ((Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).firstEnd e)
      have hf : (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).firstEnd e ∈ U i := by
        rw [← hparts]
        simp [mem_labelShore,i]
      have hs : (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).secondEnd e ∈ U i := by
        rw [← hparts]
        simp only [mem_labelShore,mem_singleton]
        exact heq.symm
      have hinner := ((Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).mem_internalEdges (U i) e).mpr ⟨hf,hs⟩
      rcases hindices i with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hez hinner
      · exact hew hinner
      · exact hex hinner
      · exact hey hinner
    have hp : e ∈ univ.biUnion M := by
      have hh : univ.biUnion M = joiningCopies (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R) label := by
        simpa only [hinst] using hpartsM
      rwa [hh]
    obtain ⟨j,_,hj⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hp
    exact ⟨j,hj⟩
  have hcutOn (A : Finset V) (N : Finset R.edgeSet) :
      (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).cutOn N A = N ∩ (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R).cutEdges A := by
    ext e
    simp only [Multigraph.mem_cutOn,mem_inter,Multigraph.mem_cutEdges]
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := hfactor V R.edgeSet (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R)
    (U z) (U w) (U x) (U y) (C z) (C w) (C x) (C y) (h-P.rounds) a
    (hdisjoint hzw) (hdisjoint hzx) (hdisjoint hzy)
    (hdisjoint hwx) (hdisjoint hwy) (hdisjoint hxy)
    (by intro v
        obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hcover v
        rcases hindices i with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact Or.inl hi
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hi)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hi))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hi)))
    (Nat.even_iff.mpr (by simpa [hzx,hzy] using hparity z))
    (Nat.even_iff.mpr (by simpa [hwx,hwy] using hparity w))
    (Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by simpa using hparity x))
    (Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by simpa using hparity y))
    (hm z) (hm w) (hm x) (hm y) hregular hk (hsize z) (hsize w)
    (hrobust z) (hrobust w) (hrobust x) (hrobust y)
    (ha z) (ha w) (ha x) (ha y) (hdegree z) (hdegree w) (hdegree x) (hdegree y)
    M hM hdM hcoverM
    (by intro j; simpa only [hinst,← hcutOn] using hcut j x (Or.inl rfl))
    (by intro j; simpa only [hinst,← hcutOn] using hcut j y (Or.inr rfl))
    (by intro j
        apply ((hM j).uncovered_even_iff_cut_parity (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R) (U z)).mpr
        simpa only [hinst] using (hpar j z).symm)
    (by intro j
        apply ((hM j).uncovered_even_iff_cut_parity (Multigraph.ofSimpleGraph R) (U w)).mpr
        simpa only [hinst] using (hpar j w).symm)
  exact completion_restores_coloring P.completion P.rounds_le c

end Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check fetched published bytes against the immutable full-verification evidence."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
BASELINE_COMMIT = "1c9404a454c99fe5c11ba8d774cb9c259f291f20"
DEFAULT_BASELINE_TREE = "087e26b5f004af1f9423a6f2b137d805f5991f1a"

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--commit", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--tree", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--parent", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--output", required=True)
args = ap.parse_args()
if not all(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", x) for x in [args.commit, args.tree, args.parent]):
    raise SystemExit("Exact 40-character commit, tree, and parent IDs are required")
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
RUN = Path("verification/runs/20261124T213000Z")
GIT_ENV = {**os.environ, "GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH": "1", "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0"}
def git(*argv):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *argv], cwd=ROOT, env=GIT_ENV)
def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
commit = git("rev-parse", args.commit + "^{commit}").decode().strip()
tree = git("rev-parse", commit + "^{tree}").decode().strip()
parents = git("show", "-s", "--format=%P", commit).decode().strip().split()
require(commit == args.commit, "Commit differs from the exact requested object")
require(tree == args.tree, ("Tree mismatch", tree, args.tree))
require(parents == [args.parent], ("Parent mismatch", parents))
entries = {}
for entry in git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", commit).split(b"\0"):
    if entry:
        meta, path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, kind, oid = meta.decode().split()
        entries[path.decode()] = (mode, kind, oid)
reader = subprocess.Popen(["git", "cat-file", "--batch"], cwd=ROOT,
                          stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, env=GIT_ENV)
cache = {}
def read(path):
    mode, kind, oid = entries[str(path)]
    require(kind == "blob" and mode in {"100644", "100755"}, ("Expected regular Git blob", path, mode, kind))
    if oid not in cache:
        reader.stdin.write((oid + "\n").encode())
        reader.stdin.flush()
        header = reader.stdout.readline().decode().strip().split()
        require(header[:2] == [oid, "blob"], ("Unexpected cat-file header", header))
        data = reader.stdout.read(int(header[2]))
        require(len(data) == int(header[2]), "Truncated blob read")
        require(reader.stdout.read(1) == b"\n", "Missing blob separator")
        actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
        require(actual == oid, ("Blob hash mismatch", oid, actual))
        cache[oid] = data
    return cache[oid]
def parsed(path):
    return json.loads(read(path))
frozen_path = RUN / "full-01/frozen-inputs.json"
controls_path = RUN / "full-01/frozen-controls.json"
terminal_path = RUN / "full-01/terminal.json"
frozen = parsed(frozen_path)
controls = parsed(controls_path)
terminal = parsed(terminal_path)
require(frozen and controls, "Empty frozen inputs or controls")
require(terminal["baseline_commit"] == BASELINE_COMMIT and terminal["baseline_tree"] == DEFAULT_BASELINE_TREE,
        "Terminal baseline differs from the verified continuation baseline")
require(terminal["frozen_input_count"] == len(frozen) and terminal["control_sha256"] == controls,
        "Terminal inventories differ from the frozen manifests")
require(terminal["command"] == ["python3", "scripts/verify.py"]
        and terminal["attempt"] == "full-01"
        and terminal["changed_inputs"] == [] and terminal["changed_controls"] == []
        and terminal["status"] == "passed" and terminal["exit_code"] == 0 and terminal["wrapper_exit_code"] == 0
        and terminal["preflight_passed"] is True and terminal["verifier_launched"] is True
        and terminal["inputs_unchanged"] is True and terminal["controls_unchanged"] is True
        and terminal["wrapper_errors"] == [] and terminal["missing_principal_outputs"] == [],
        "The complete frozen verifier did not pass")
require(read(terminal_path) == read(RUN / "full-01/command.json"), "Command and terminal receipts differ")
require(read(frozen_path) == (ROOT / frozen_path).read_bytes(), "Published frozen-input manifest differs")
require(read(controls_path) == (ROOT / controls_path).read_bytes(), "Published frozen-control manifest differs")
require(sha(read(RUN / "full-01/output.log")) == terminal["output_sha256"], "Full-run output log differs")
preservation_data = read(RUN / "preservation.json")
preservation = json.loads(preservation_data)
coverage = preservation.get("coverage", {})
require(preservation.get("status") == "passed"
        and preservation.get("actual_full_verifier_exit") == 0
        and preservation.get("full_verifier_attempt") == "full-01"
        and preservation.get("baseline_commit") == BASELINE_COMMIT
        and preservation.get("baseline_tree") == DEFAULT_BASELINE_TREE
        and preservation.get("genuine_command_receipt_sha256") == sha(read(terminal_path))
        and preservation.get("frozen_input_count") == len(frozen)
        and preservation.get("all_previous_declarations_owners_axiom_sets_preserved") is True
        and preservation.get("all_previous_completed_result_mappings_preserved") is True
        and preservation.get("all_previous_source_declaration_maps_preserved") is True
        and coverage.get("numbered_assertions") == 69
        and coverage.get("previous_complete") == 49
        and coverage.get("current_complete") == 51
        and coverage.get("promoted_assertions") == ["4.16", "4.17"]
        and coverage.get("all_69_statement_identities_identical") is True
        and coverage.get("all_unpromoted_records_identical") is True
        and coverage.get("main_theorem_verified") is False,
        "Preservation does not certify the exact successful fresh run and scope")

# Reconstruct the complete verifier input inventory directly from the fetched
# Git tree, without importing or executing code supplied by that tree.
fixed_inputs = {"Overfull.lean", "Audit.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.toml",
                "lake-manifest.json", "README.md", ".github/workflows/lean.yml",
                "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt", "CIRCULATION_NOTICE.txt", "LICENSE_BMATCHING.txt"}
def is_verifier_input(name):
    path = Path(name)
    return (name in fixed_inputs
            or (name.startswith("Overfull/") and path.suffix == ".lean")
            or (len(path.parts) == 2 and path.parts[0] == "scripts" and path.suffix == ".py")
            or (len(path.parts) == 2 and path.parts[0] == "docs" and path.suffix in {".json", ".md"})
            or (len(path.parts) == 2 and path.parts[0] == "patches" and path.suffix == ".patch"))
require({name for name in entries if is_verifier_input(name)} == set(frozen),
        "Fetched verifier input path set differs from the complete frozen inventory")
checks = []
def check(path, expected, size=None):
    data = read(path)
    actual = sha(data)
    require(actual == expected, ("Content digest mismatch", str(path), expected, actual))
    if size is not None:
        require(len(data) == size, ("Content size mismatch", str(path)))
    checks.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": actual, "bytes": len(data)})
for name, digest in frozen.items():
    check(name, digest)
    check(RUN / "full-01/input" / name, digest)
    require(sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == digest, ("Working frozen input changed", name))
for name, digest in controls.items():
    check(RUN / name, digest)
    check(RUN / "full-01/control" / name, digest)
    require(sha((ROOT / RUN / name).read_bytes()) == digest, ("Working frozen control changed", name))
for output in terminal["outputs"]:
    check(output["path"], output["sha256"], output["bytes"])
    check(RUN / "full-01/artifacts" / output["path"], output["sha256"], output["bytes"])
output_paths = {output["path"] for output in terminal["outputs"]}
require(len(output_paths) == len(terminal["outputs"]) and output_paths, "Duplicate or empty output inventory")
scope = parsed(RUN / "verification-scope.json")
require({"verification/results.json", "verification/build.log", "verification/axioms.log",
         scope["declaration_map"]} <= output_paths, "Principal verifier output is missing")
artifact_prefix = str(RUN / "full-01/artifacts") + "/"
require({name.removeprefix(artifact_prefix) for name in entries if name.startswith(artifact_prefix)} == output_paths,
        "Published archived-output inventory differs from terminal receipt")
run_paths = [name for name in entries
             if name.startswith(str(RUN) + "/")
             and not name.startswith(str(RUN / "publication") + "/")]
local_run_paths = {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in (ROOT / RUN).rglob("*")
                   if p.is_file() and ROOT / RUN / "publication" not in p.parents
                   and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and p != ROOT / RUN / "build.lock"}
require(set(run_paths) == local_run_paths, "Published nonpublication run inventory differs from local evidence")
for name in run_paths:
    require(read(name) == (ROOT / name).read_bytes(), ("Published run evidence differs", name))
results = parsed("verification/results.json")
require(results["lean_build_passed"] is True and results["axiom_audit_passed"] is True
        and results["fully_verified_numbered_assertion_count"] == 51
        and results["main_theorem_verified"] is False
        and results["verified_declaration_count"] == preservation["audited_declarations"]
        and {**results["source_sha256"], **results["verification_input_sha256"]} == frozen,
        "Full verifier report differs from the frozen proof and preservation report")
reader.stdin.close()
require(reader.wait() == 0, "git cat-file failed")
result = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "kind": "fetched_public_commit_integrity",
    "verified_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "commit": commit,
    "tree": tree,
    "parent": parents[0],
    "tracked_file_count": len(entries),
    "continuation_baseline_commit": BASELINE_COMMIT,
    "continuation_baseline_tree": DEFAULT_BASELINE_TREE,
    "frozen_input_count": len(frozen),
    "frozen_control_count": len(controls),
    "archived_output_count": len(terminal["outputs"]),
    "nonpublication_run_file_count": len(run_paths),
    "explicit_digest_checks": len(checks),
    "unique_blob_bytes_checked": len(cache),
    "all_published_and_frozen_bytes_match": True,
    "complete_fetched_verifier_input_inventory_matches": True,
    "preservation_report_sha256": sha(preservation_data),
    "preservation_passed_on_exact_terminal_receipt": True,
    "audited_declarations": results["verified_declaration_count"],
    "new_audited_declarations": preservation["new_audited_declarations"],
    "completed_result_mappings": len(results["completed_results"]),
    "complete_numbered_assertions": 51,
    "total_numbered_assertions": 69,
    "main_theorem_verified": False,
    "all_nonpublication_run_files_match_working_evidence": True,
    "command_and_terminal_identical": True,
    "full_verifier_exit_code": terminal["exit_code"],
    "full_wrapper_exit_code": terminal["wrapper_exit_code"],
    "passed": True,
    "checks": checks,
}
destination = ROOT / args.output
destination.open("x").write(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "checks"}, indent=2))

import Overfull.ResidualPalette.PaletteGrouping

/-!
# Endpoint-compatible grouping with arbitrary bounded piece size

Pieces with at most `s` original copies have at most `2*s*D` conflicting
indices under a vertex incidence bound `D`. The greedy construction retains
all prescribed primary seeds and every original copy. Its class-size and
support bounds are `s*L` and `2*s*L`; for four-copy pieces these are `4*L`
and `8*L`, with conflict allowance `8*D`.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace Overfull.NativeReserve

open Finset Classical
open scoped BigOperators

variable {V E I : Type*} [Fintype I]

theorem pieceConflict_card_le_of_size (G : Multigraph V E) (M : I → Finset E)
    (S : Finset E) (D s : ℕ) (hsize : ∀ i, (M i).card ≤ s)
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (M i) (M j)))
    (hsubset : ∀ i, M i ⊆ S) (hdegree : ∀ v, G.degreeOn S v ≤ D) (i : I) :
    (univ.filter (pieceConflict G M i)).card ≤ 2*s*D := by
  have hsub : univ.filter (pieceConflict G M i) ⊆
      univ.filter (fun j => ¬ Disjoint (G.edgeSupport (M i)) (G.edgeSupport (M j))) := by
    intro j hj
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hj).2.2⟩
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans
    ((CircuitPatterns.support_conflicts_card_le (G.edgeSupport (M i))
      (fun j => G.edgeSupport (M j)) D (fun v _ =>
        (G.family_support_load_le_degreeOn M S hdisjoint hsubset v).trans (hdegree v))).trans
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_right D ((G.edgeSupport_card_le _).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (hsize i)))))

theorem groupedCopies_card_le_of_size {h L s : ℕ} (M : I → Finset E) (c : I → Fin h)
    (hsize : ∀ i, (M i).card ≤ s)
    (hload : ∀ i, (univ.filter (fun j => c j = i)).card ≤ L) (i : Fin h) :
    (groupedCopies M c i).card ≤ s*L := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j => c j = i), (M j).card := card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ univ.filter (fun j => c j = i), s := sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hsize j)
    _ = s*(univ.filter (fun j => c j = i)).card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
    _ ≤ s*L := Nat.mul_le_mul_left s (hload i)

theorem groupedCopies_support_card_le_of_size {h L s : ℕ} (G : Multigraph V E)
    (M : I → Finset E) (c : I → Fin h) (hsize : ∀ i, (M i).card ≤ s)
    (hload : ∀ i, (univ.filter (fun j => c j = i)).card ≤ L) (i : Fin h) :
    (G.edgeSupport (groupedCopies M c i)).card ≤ 2*s*L := by
  have hh := (G.edgeSupport_card_le _).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (groupedCopies_card_le_of_size M c hsize hload i))
  simpa only [← Nat.mul_assoc] using hh

theorem exists_bounded_matching_grouping_of_size {h D L s : ℕ}
    (G : Multigraph V E) (M : I → Finset E) (S : Finset E)
    (P : Finset I) (c₀ : I → Fin h)
    (hprimary : Set.InjOn c₀ P)
    (hM : ∀ i, G.IsMatching (M i)) (hsize : ∀ i, (M i).card ≤ s)
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (M i) (M j)))
    (hsubset : ∀ i, M i ⊆ S) (hdegree : ∀ v, G.degreeOn S v ≤ D)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hDh : 2*s*D < h) (hbudget : Fintype.card I ≤ L*(h-2*s*D)) :
    ∃ c : I → Fin h,
      (∀ i ∈ P, c i = c₀ i) ∧
      (∀ i, (univ.filter (fun j => c j = i)).card ≤ L) ∧
      (∀ i, G.IsMatching (groupedCopies M c i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (groupedCopies M c i) (groupedCopies M c j)) ∧
      univ.biUnion (groupedCopies M c) = univ.biUnion M ∧
      (∀ i, (groupedCopies M c i).card ≤ s*L) ∧
      (∀ i, (G.edgeSupport (groupedCopies M c i)).card ≤ 2*s*L) := by
  have hsymm : Symmetric (pieceConflict G M) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact ⟨hij.1.symm, fun hh => hij.2 hh.symm⟩
  have hirrefl : Irreflexive (pieceConflict G M) := fun _ hh => hh.1 rfl
  have hp : ∀ i ∈ P, ∀ j ∈ P, pieceConflict G M i j → c₀ i ≠ c₀ j := by
    intro i hi j hj hij hc
    exact hij.1 (hprimary hi hj hc)
  have hl : ∀ i, (P.filter (fun j => c₀ j = i)).card ≤ L := by
    intro i
    have hh : (P.filter (fun j => c₀ j = i)).card ≤ 1 := by
      apply card_le_one.mpr
      intro j hj k hk
      exact hprimary (mem_filter.mp hj).1 (mem_filter.mp hk).1
        ((mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hk).2.symm)
    omega
  obtain ⟨c, hcP, hcproper, hcload⟩ := exists_bounded_palette_extension
    (pieceConflict G M) hsymm hirrefl univ P (subset_univ _) c₀ hp hl
    (fun i _ => pieceConflict_card_le_of_size G M S D s hsize hdisjoint hsubset hdegree i)
    hDh (by simpa only [card_univ] using hbudget)
  refine ⟨c, hcP, hcload, ?_, groupedCopies_disjoint M c hdisjoint,
    groupedCopies_cover M c, groupedCopies_card_le_of_size M c hsize hcload,
    groupedCopies_support_card_le_of_size G M c hsize hcload⟩
  exact groupedCopies_isMatching G M c hM (fun i j => hcproper i (mem_univ _) j (mem_univ _))

theorem palette_capacity_of_incidence_budget_of_size [Fintype V]
    {h D L s : ℕ} (G : Multigraph V E) (M : I → Finset E) (S : Finset E)
    (hne : ∀ i, (M i).Nonempty)
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (M i) (M j)))
    (hsubset : ∀ i, M i ⊆ S) (hdegree : ∀ v, G.degreeOn S v ≤ D)
    (hbudget : Fintype.card V*D ≤ 2*L*(h-2*s*D)) :
    Fintype.card I ≤ L*(h-2*s*D) := by
  have hh := twice_piece_count_le_order_mul_degree G M S D hne hdisjoint hsubset hdegree
  nlinarith

end Overfull.NativeReserve

import Overfull.Terminal.CentralMatchings

/-! Both even cores embed in the central graph on their union and two apices. -/

noncomputable section

namespace Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd

open Finset Classical Multigraph SmallCuts Terminal

variable {V E : Type*}

def keptVertex {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) (w : W) : CentralVertex S :=
  Sum.inl ⟨w.val, hWS w.property⟩

theorem keptVertex_injective {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) :
    Function.Injective (keptVertex hWS) := by
  intro u v h
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : S => z.val) (Sum.inl_injective h))

def keptSet {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) : Finset (CentralVertex S) :=
  univ.image (keptVertex hWS)

@[simp] theorem keptSet_card {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) :
    (keptSet hWS).card = W.card := by
  rw [keptSet, card_image_of_injective _ (keptVertex_injective hWS)]
  simp

@[simp] theorem inl_mem_keptSet {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) (u : S) :
    Sum.inl u ∈ keptSet hWS ↔ u.val ∈ W := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := mem_image.mp h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inl_injective hw)) ▸ w.property
  · intro h
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨u.val,h⟩,mem_univ _,congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext rfl)⟩

@[simp] theorem apex_not_mem_keptSet {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) (i : Fin 2) :
    Sum.inr i ∉ keptSet hWS := by
  simp [keptSet, keptVertex]

theorem centralMap_mem_keptSet {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (A : Finset V) (v : V) : centralMap S A v ∈ keptSet hWS ↔ v ∈ W := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ S
  · rw [show centralMap S A v = Sum.inl (⟨v,hv⟩ : S) from centralMap_core S A ⟨v,hv⟩]
    exact inl_mem_keptSet hWS ⟨v,hv⟩
  · have hn : v ∉ W := fun hw => hv (hWS hw)
    by_cases ha : v ∈ A <;> simp [centralMap,hv,ha,hn]

def keptEquiv {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) : W ≃ ↥(keptSet hWS) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun w => ⟨keptVertex hWS w,mem_image.mpr ⟨w,mem_univ _,rfl⟩⟩) (by
    constructor
    · intro u v h
      exact keptVertex_injective hWS (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
      obtain ⟨w,_,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
      exact ⟨w,rfl⟩)

theorem keptEquiv_symm_val {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) (v : keptSet hWS) :
    keptVertex hWS ((keptEquiv hWS).symm v) = v.val :=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((keptEquiv hWS).apply_symm_apply v)

def keptCoreEdgeMap {G : Multigraph V E} {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (C : Core G W) (A : Finset V) : C.graph.edgeSet ↪ CentralEdge G S A where
  toFun e := ⟨C.edgeMap e,central_retained_of_core_incident G S A
    (hWS e.val.out.1.property) (by
      rw [C.map_edge]
      exact Sym2.mem_map.mpr ⟨e.val.out.1,e.val.out_fst_mem,rfl⟩)⟩
  inj' := by
    intro e f h
    exact C.edgeMap.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)

theorem keptCoreEdgeMap_edge {G : Multigraph V E} {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (C : Core G W) (A : Finset V) (e : C.graph.edgeSet) :
    (centralGraph G S A).edge (keptCoreEdgeMap hWS C A e) =
      Sym2.map (keptVertex hWS) e.val := by
  rw [centralGraph_edge]
  change Sym2.map (centralMap S A) (G.edge (C.edgeMap e)) = _
  rw [C.map_edge,Sym2.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext w
  exact centralMap_core S A ⟨w.val,hWS w.property⟩

def keptCore {G : Multigraph V E} {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (C : Core G W) (A : Finset V) : Core (centralGraph G S A) (keptSet hWS) where
  graph := C.graph.comap (keptEquiv hWS).symm
  edgeMap := (SimpleGraph.Iso.comap (keptEquiv hWS).symm C.graph).mapEdgeSet.toEmbedding.trans
    (keptCoreEdgeMap hWS C A)
  map_edge e := by
    rw [Function.Embedding.trans_apply,keptCoreEdgeMap_edge]
    change Sym2.map (keptVertex hWS) (Sym2.map (keptEquiv hWS).symm e.val) =
      Sym2.map Subtype.val e.val
    rw [Sym2.map_map]
    congr 1
    funext v
    exact keptEquiv_symm_val hWS v

instance keptCoreAdjDecidable {G : Multigraph V E} {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (C : Core G W) (A : Finset V) [DecidableRel C.graph.Adj] :
    DecidableRel (keptCore hWS C A).graph.Adj :=
  inferInstanceAs (DecidableRel (C.graph.comap (keptEquiv hWS).symm).Adj)

theorem keptCore_degree {G : Multigraph V E} {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (C : Core G W) (A : Finset V) [DecidableRel C.graph.Adj] (v : keptSet hWS) :
    (keptCore hWS C A).graph.degree v = C.graph.degree ((keptEquiv hWS).symm v) :=
  RobustRealization.comap_equiv_degree C.graph (keptEquiv hWS).symm v

theorem keptCore_robust {G : Multigraph V E} {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (C : Core G W) (A : Finset V) [DecidableRel C.graph.Adj] (ν τ : ℝ)
    (hC : IsRobustExpander C.graph ν τ) :
    IsRobustExpander (keptCore hWS C A).graph ν τ :=
  RobustRealization.robust_comap_equiv C.graph (keptEquiv hWS).symm ν τ hC

theorem keptSet_disjoint {S U W : Finset V} (hUS : U ⊆ S) (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (hUW : Disjoint U W) : Disjoint (keptSet hUS) (keptSet hWS) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro (u | i) hu hw
  · exact disjoint_left.mp hUW ((inl_mem_keptSet hUS u).mp hu)
      ((inl_mem_keptSet hWS u).mp hw)
  · exact apex_not_mem_keptSet hUS i hu

def centralApices (S : Finset V) : Finset (CentralVertex S) :=
  univ.image (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → CentralVertex S)

@[simp] theorem centralApices_card (S : Finset V) : (centralApices S).card = 2 := by
  rw [centralApices,card_image_of_injective _ Sum.inr_injective]
  simp

@[simp] theorem centralApices_inl (S : Finset V) (u : S) :
    Sum.inl u ∉ centralApices S := by simp [centralApices]

@[simp] theorem centralApices_inr (S : Finset V) (i : Fin 2) :
    Sum.inr i ∈ centralApices S := by simp [centralApices]

theorem keptSet_disjoint_apices {S W : Finset V} (hWS : W ⊆ S) :
    Disjoint (keptSet hWS) (centralApices S) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro (u | i) h hZ
  · exact centralApices_inl S u hZ
  · exact apex_not_mem_keptSet hWS i h

theorem central_two_core_cover (U W : Finset V) (v : CentralVertex (U ∪ W)) :
    v ∈ keptSet (subset_union_left : U ⊆ U ∪ W) ∨
      v ∈ keptSet (subset_union_right : W ⊆ U ∪ W) ∨ v ∈ centralApices (U ∪ W) := by
  rcases v with u | i
  · rcases mem_union.mp u.property with hu | hw
    · exact Or.inl ((inl_mem_keptSet subset_union_left u).mpr hu)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ((inl_mem_keptSet subset_union_right u).mpr hw))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (centralApices_inr _ i))

end Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd

import Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd.CutCertificates
import Overfull.NativeTerminal.BoundedInput

/-! Uniform two-core central factorization certified by actual joining matchings. -/

noncomputable section

namespace Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd

open Finset Classical Multigraph SmallCuts NativeReserve ForceMatching

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
theorem exists_uniform_two_core_central_coloring (α ν τ : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hν : 0 < ν) (hντ : ν ≤ τ)
    (hτ : τ ≤ α/64) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∃ n₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
        (G : Multigraph V E) (U W Z : Finset V) (C₀ : Core G U) (C₁ : Core G W)
        (k : ℕ) (a : ℝ),
        n₀ ≤ Fintype.card V → Even (Fintype.card V) →
        Disjoint U W → Disjoint U Z → Disjoint W Z →
        (∀ v, v ∈ U ∨ v ∈ W ∨ v ∈ Z) → Z.card ≤ 2 →
        (∀ v, G.degree v = k) → α*Fintype.card V ≤ (k : ℝ) →
        α*Fintype.card V ≤ (U.card : ℝ) → α*Fintype.card V ≤ (W.card : ℝ) →
        IsRobustExpander C₀.graph ν τ → IsRobustExpander C₁.graph ν τ →
        a ≤ ε*Fintype.card V →
        (∀ v, (k : ℝ)-a ≤ (C₀.graph.degree v : ℝ)) →
        (∀ v, (k : ℝ)-a ≤ (C₁.graph.degree v : ℝ)) →
        (M : Fin k → Finset E) → (∀ j, G.IsMatching (M j)) →
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (M i) (M j)) →
        (∀ e, e ∉ G.internalEdges U → e ∉ G.internalEdges W → ∃ j, e ∈ M j) →
        (∀ j, Z ⊆ G.edgeSupport (M j)) →
        (∀ j, Even (U \ G.edgeSupport (M j)).card) →
        (∀ j, Even (W \ G.edgeSupport (M j)).card) →
        Nonempty (G.EdgeColoring k) := by
  have hτfactor : τ ≤ min α (min α 1)/16 := by
    rw [min_eq_left hα1,min_self]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨η,hη,mfactor,_hmfactor,hfactor⟩ := bounded_input_factorization α α ν τ
    hα hα hν hντ hτfactor
  obtain ⟨mcut,hmcut⟩ := exists_order_threshold α ν hα hν
  let ε := min (α/10) (η/2)
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨ε,hε,max (max mcut mfactor) (max 1 ⌈2/η⌉₊),?_⟩
  intro V E _ _ G U W Z C₀ C₁ k a hn heven hUW hUZ hWZ hcover hZ
    hregular hk hU hW hrobU hrobW ha hdegU hdegW M hM hdM hcoverM hZM hparU hparW
  have hncut : mcut ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hn)
  have hnfactor : mfactor ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans hn)
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hn)
  have hnceil : ⌈2/η⌉₊ ≤ Fintype.card V :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hn)
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Fintype.card V by omega)
  have hUpos : 0 < U.card := by
    have hh := (mul_pos hα hnpos).trans_le hU
    exact_mod_cast hh
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := card_pos.mp hUpos
  have hdeglt : (C₀.graph.degree ⟨v,hv⟩ : ℝ) < U.card := by
    exact_mod_cast C₀.graph.degree_lt_card_verts ⟨v,hv⟩
  have hUn : (U.card : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast card_le_univ U
  have hasmall : a ≤ α*Fintype.card V/10 := by
    have hh := ha.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left (α/10) (η/2))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card V)))
    dsimp [ε] at ha
    linarith
  have hkhi : (k : ℝ) ≤ 2*Fintype.card V := by
    have hd := hdegU ⟨v,hv⟩
    have haBound : a ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ)/10 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα1 (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card V))]
    linarith
  let parts : Fin 2 → Finset V := ![U,W]
  let cores : ∀ i, Core G (parts i) := by
    refine Fin.cases C₀ ?_
    refine Fin.cases C₁ ?_
    intro i
    exact i.elim0
  have hparts : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (parts i) (parts j)) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hUW
    · exact hUW.symm
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  have hpartsZ : ∀ i, Disjoint (parts i) Z := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hUZ
    · exact hWZ
  have hwholeCover (X : Finset V) (hX : X ∈ wholeUnions parts Z) :
      G.cutEdges X ⊆ univ.biUnion M := by
    apply whole_cut_covered G parts Z hparts hpartsZ _ ?_ X hX
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hcoverM e (he 0) (he 1)
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j,mem_univ _,hj⟩
  have hwholeParity (X : Finset V) (hX : X ∈ wholeUnions parts Z) (j : Fin k) :
      (G.cutOn (M j) X).card % 2 = X.card % 2 := by
    apply whole_matching_cut_parity G parts Z hparts (M j) (hM j) (hZM j) ?_ X hX
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hparU j
    · exact hparW j
  have hno : ∀ X : Finset V, ¬ G.IsOverfull k X := by
    apply no_overfull_of_whole_cut_bounds G parts Z hparts hpartsZ
      (fun v => by rcases hcover v with h | h | h
                   · exact Or.inr ⟨0,h⟩
                   · exact Or.inr ⟨1,h⟩
                   · exact Or.inl h)
      k hregular cores α α ν τ a hα hα hν (hν.trans_le hντ).le
      (by linarith) hk hkhi hasmall (hmcut _ hncut)
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact hU
      · exact hW
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact hrobU
      · exact hrobW
    · intro i v
      fin_cases i
      · exact hdegU v
      · exact hdegW v
    · intro X hX hodd
      exact matching_partition_odd_cut G k M hdM X (hwholeCover X hX)
        (fun j => (hwholeParity X hX j).trans hodd)
    · intro X hX hevenX v
      exact toggle_safe_of_incidence G k hregular X v
        (matching_partition_even_incidence G k M hM hdM X (hwholeCover X hX)
          (fun j => (hwholeParity X hX j).trans hevenX) v)
  have hone : 1 ≤ η/2*Fintype.card V := by
    have hceil : (2/η : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card V :=
      (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by exact_mod_cast hnceil)
    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hη).mp hceil
    nlinarith
  have haη : a ≤ η/2*Fintype.card V := ha.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right (α/10) (η/2)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  exact hfactor V E G k a hnfactor heven hregular hk hno (by linarith)
    (Or.inr ⟨U,W,Z,C₀,C₁,hUW,hUZ,hWZ,hcover,hZ,hU,hW,hrobU,hrobW,hdegU,hdegW⟩)

end Overfull.TerminalFourTwoOdd

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only final preflight; this is not a full verifier pass."""
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
RUN = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("preservation", RUN / "check-preservation.py")
checks = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(checks)
result = checks.preflight()
result["kind"] = "final_preflight_only"
result["current_input_count"] = len(checks.current_inputs())
result["current_control_count"] = len(checks.current_controls())
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
